# Start building with Microsoft

Microsoft offers advanced supercomputing and industry-leading security and privacy, along with access to the latest AI models and developer tools so you can build faster and stay ahead the curve. We are committed to supporting startups at every stage — from first line of code to global scale.

We help startups:

- Build fast: discover scalable AI tools that help cut costs and future-proof their business
- Scale smart: deploy with peace of mind with a cloud designed for enterprise-ready scale and security
- Sell more: boost go-to-market success with access to the Microsoft global network of customers

![briefcase icon](https://stfoundershubprod.blob.core.windows.net/client/media/Briefcase.84a9155e.svg)

## Redeem your investor referral code

Startups affiliated with the Microsoft for Startups Investor Network get up to $150,000 USD in credits and are eligible for a higher level of support.

This includes:

Azure credits

Access to advanced AI services and GPUs

Enhanced benefits, increased expert technical guidance, and go-to-market support

[Apply with your code](https://portal.startups.microsoft.com/referral)

![code icon](https://stfoundershubprod.blob.core.windows.net/client/media/Code.acb4c9c1.svg)

## Get started quickly

Startups can access up to $5,000 in Azure credits.

To get started:

You must be a new Azure customer with no prior Azure account

You must sign up or sign in using a valid personal Microsoft Account (MSA)

You must be in a country/region where this Azure offer is available

[Sign up with Azure](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2312920)

Read more about eligibility criteria [here](https://aka.ms/startuphelp-applying)

By submitting this application, you agree that you have read the [Microsoft Privacy Statement](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=521839) and give permission to Microsoft for Startups to collect your data and contact you regarding your application.

- 01/











### What is Microsoft for Startups, and how do I apply?




















Microsoft for Startups is a program that helps founders overcome common startup challenges by providing access to AI services, expert guidance, and essential technology. The program offers benefits like free Azure credits, AI tools, and resources to help you build, scale, and sell your solutions.

[Sign up here](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2338539) if you have an investor referral code or want to start building with Azure

- 02/











### What is the Microsoft for Startups portal?




















The Microsoft for Startups portal supports startups by providing access to various resources, benefits, and programs. Startups can tap into pre-built marketing materials, industry-leading AI services, expert guidance, and essential technology to help build and scale their businesses.

- 03/











### What are Microsoft for Startups technical benefits?




















Microsoft for Startups provides a range of technical benefits designed to help startups build and scale their businesses. These benefits include:

**Free Azure credits:** Startups receive Azure credits to help them get started with building their solutions quickly and efficiently on the Azure platform.

**Access to AI tools:** Startups can leverage industry-leading AI services and tools for software development, enabling them to create innovative and intelligent applications.

**Technical resources:** Startups have access to various resources that assist in building better products, scaling faster, and increasing sales. This includes documentation, guides, and support to help with replication and modernization journeys.

## Content types

- [News](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/content-type/news/)

## Build the next big thing

Access AI and development tools—not to mention expert guidance and Azure credits—when you join Microsoft for Startups.

[Get started](https://foundershub.startups.microsoft.com/signup)

Microsoft is evolving how we support startups. To learn more about the latest changes, visit [here](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/build-fast-scale-smart-and-sell-more-microsoft-for-startups-evolves-to-better-serve-the-startup-ecosystem/).

As a Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub member, you will receive Azure cloud credits to build your product. We have removed restrictive timelines and inflexible benefits so founders can develop at their own pace, not ours. Founders will receive customized credit offers that grow with you.

When you become a member of Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub you receive a range of benefits that grow with you as your company grows. Benefits are available at every stage of your startup journey and are designed to help accelerate your startup’s growth, provide guidance at key inflection points and help your company succeed.

## Benefits to help you build your product and team

Every entrepreneur and startup founder wrestles with stretching limited resources and making tough decisions about where to focus efforts on a tight budget. Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub was developed to help alleviate some of that worry. We provide you with the resources your company needs to build your product in the cloud and accelerate towards finding product market fit.

![software blog](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/software-blog.png)

## Build your product with Azure credits

As a Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub member, you will receive Azure cloud credits to build your product. We have removed restrictive timelines and inflexible benefits so founders can develop at their own pace, not ours. Founders will receive customized credit offers that grow with you.

As your company expands, you will become eligible for up to $150,000 in Azure credits over four years. Members also receive free 24/7 [Azure Standard Support](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-gb/support/plans/standard/).

## Increase developer velocity and automate workflows with GitHub Enterprise

All Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub members will receive up to 20 seats for one year’s subscription to GitHub Enterprise, the largest and most advanced development platform in the world. This is one of our most popular benefits, enabling startup teams to collaborate from anywhere in the world with many features to make your life easier with automated workflows.

## Tackle recruitment and upgrade lead generation with access to LinkedIn products

Addressing pain points around hiring talent, finding customers and networking with peers, qualified members can now access each of four LinkedIn products:

- [Recruiter Lite](https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions/recruiter-lite)
- [Sales Navigator Core](https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions/sales-navigator)
- [LinkedIn Premium Business](https://premium.linkedin.com/#tools-for-business-leaders)

These benefits allow startups to leverage the broad spectrum of LinkedIn services to drive their businesses forward.

## Save money and increase team productivity with Microsoft 365 and Teams

Check out our new Microsoft 365 Business Premium solution designed especially for startups. It’s a complete bundle that includes Outlook, Excel, Powerpoint, Word, Teams and more to make it easy for startups like yours to adopt and grow with Microsoft 365. Learn more about [Microsoft 365 for startups](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/m365-founders-hub/).

![Founders Hub member benefits](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/founders_hub_member_benefits.jpg)

### See how real people use your site with Microsoft Clarity

Microsoft Clarity helps your startup understand user behavior and discover ways to improve your site. Instant heatmaps show the areas on your landing pages that drive engagement and how far users scroll. Session recordings capture how people browse your site and the obstacles they face. Behavioral insights can reveal user frustrations with your UX—so you can turn problems into opportunities for success. Having robust analytics on your customers is now simpler and more affordable by combining our partner offers with the official Microsoft Clarity plugin for Bubble’s no-code web app builder.

> **Microsoft Clarity is the tool every Startup needs be customer obsessed. Identify issues on your online product and make changes that improve your KPIs.**
>
> Ravi Yada, Principal Product Manager, Microsoft Clarity

## Startup-friendly offers from trusted partners

Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub is building the most comprehensive basket of benefits for our members, teaming up with trusted partners offering best-in-class solutions.

Members will get access to offers from OpenAI, Bubble, Ansarada and more with new trusted partners being added regularly.

To learn more about these offers from trusted partners, [read this post](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/trusted-partner-benefits/).

## Work smarter with free business insights software

Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub lets you tap into the widest range of Microsoft services to ensure you always have access to the tools you need to meet your objectives.

- [**Microsoft Power Platform**](https://powerplatform.microsoft.com/en-us/): Analyze data, build solutions, automate processes, and create virtual agents with access to Power BI, Power Apps and more. Founders get 10 seats for one year.
- [**Dynamics 365**](https://dynamics.microsoft.com/en-us/): Connect your data, processes, and teams with intelligent business applications. Up to five seats for one year.
- [**Visual Studio Enterprise**](https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/vs/enterprise/): Design, build, and deploy complex enterprise applications with Video Studio, up to five seats for one year.

## Access to expertise and guidance

We have heard repeatedly from entrepreneurs about their struggle to find the right expertise and the lack of one-to-one support when encountering technical challenges. Our expert network and other guidance benefits are aimed at closing this support gap for you and your company.

### Expert Network

Having a strong and diverse network of advisors is crucial to startups in the growth phase. We are making this historically inaccessible resource available to Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub members through our Expert Network. With a carefully curated team of experts from a variety of backgrounds, you will be able to request one-on-one time with the people who can guide you on any number of topics, from idea validation to fundraising and networking.

![Expert Network screenshot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Expert-Network-Screenshot_external-ready-1024x704.png)

### Self-guided learning and personalized training content

No one expects every founder to be an expert in all things from day one. Along your journey you will encounter new ideas that raise questions you never knew to ask. To help you with all the things you don’t know, Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub has developed tailored training paths for founders to help you expand your core skillset and learn more about running a business, building a team and making your startup attractive to investors and customers. This easy-to-access content is designed to help founders get to the next level. Available to all members.

### Pair with an Azure engineer

As you scale your business, Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub will provide you with access to technical advisory sessions that include personalized build recommendations and best practices for building on Azure. Due to program constraints, this benefit is not currently available to all members, but we hope to extend this to all founders shortly.

To learn more about our mentorship and guidance benefits, [read this post](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/blog/mentorshipprimer/).

![Microsoft for Startups](https://mlz1ypajmcke.i.optimole.com/cb:Mstr.17319/w:1280/h:720/q:mauto/f:best/https://www.feisworld.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Feisworld-blog-thumbnails-37.png)

It’s not easy running a startup. Yet more creators and founders are joining the fray than ever before. Thanks to the Great Resignation and working from home, we no longer want to park our ideas on the shelf; it’s time to take action. Welcome to one of the most incredible programs we have ever witnessed: **Microsoft for Startups**. This program is open to anyone with an idea. As a startup founder, you can unlock so many free benefits, valuable credits, and even access to business and technology experts, completely free of charge.

Getting started is easy. In this article, we reveal the suite of benefits, apps, and credits you will have access to immediately upon approval. We’ll be sharing our personal experience as founders of [PodIntelligence](http://podintelligence.com/), an AI-powered micro content creation tool for webinars and tutorial creators.

Ready? Let’s dive in!

## What is Microsoft for Startups?

Microsoft for Startups is a program and initiative launched by Microsoft to support and empower startups around the world. The program offers a variety of resources, tools, and benefits to help early-stage companies grow and succeed.

Here are some key components and features of Microsoft for Startups:

1. Access to Technology (Microsoft tools among others)
2. Co-Selling Opportunities
3. Technical Support
4. Business and Sales Support
5. Networking and Connections
6. Credits and Discounts
7. Azure Marketplace Integration
8. Startups with Social Impact

[get started with microsoft for startups (free)](https://foundershub.startups.microsoft.com/signup)

## AI Video Tutorial

Thanks to [Synthesia](https://www.feisworld.com/go/synthesia-io "Synthesia.io")’s AI video assistant, this video is generated automatically from this post.

## Free credits to scale your business with AI

Although Microsoft for Startups isn’t about throwing cash at you, they offer something even more powerful and scalable for creators and founders like you and me. Let’s take a look at their generous credits and offerings:

1. Build with AI from day one with **$2,500** of OpenAI credits and up to **$150,000** of Azure credits to use across Azure AI services. Note: Some the Microsoft and OpenAI emails and web pages that talk about this benefit say it’s for GPT 3.5 and some suggest it’s for GPT 4.0. We were psyched to find out upon approval, that as of December 2023, the OpenAI credits are for GPT 4 and related API’s.
2. Automate feature implementation with free access to **Azure OpenAI Service, including GPT-4\*, ChatGPT, and DALL·E 2** for every level of expertise. (\* _GPT-4 currently available by waitlist only_)
3. Deploy with peace of mind, knowing all deployments are secure and backed by **[Microsoft’s principles for responsible AI](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2235870)**.
4. Receive guidance from experts by pairing with Microsoft Azure technologists and business specialists.

## Free access and discounts to **Microsoft tools and platforms**

As part of Microsoft for Startups, you can access a suite of Microsoft products for free, or with deep discounts. For example, obtaining software and services like Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, GitHub Enterprise, Visual Studio, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Microsoft Power Platform for free or at significantly reduced costs can result in substantial savings for startup founders. The potential savings can vary widely based on the size of the startup, the number of users, and the specific services utilized. We are talking about hundreds and sometimes thousands of dollars worth of savings for founders.

The number of benefits is too long to list. Take a look at the image below, you can click on it to enlarge and see more details.

![Microsoft for Startups](https://mlz1ypajmcke.i.optimole.com/cb:Mstr.17319/w:618/h:1024/q:eco/f:best/https://www.feisworld.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/screencapture-foundershub-startups-microsoft-benefits-2023-12-15-15_20_13.png)

## Free access to expert guidance to grow your startup

Perhaps one of the most valuable and incomparable advantages of Microsoft for Startups is the ability to access 1:1 advisory and subject matter experts (SME). Here’s what they mean:

- Access 1:1 technical advisory with expert engineers at any stage to get help across a range of topics, including learning the latest in AI, choosing the right products, optimizing infrastructure, reducing costs, boosting performance, and road mapping.
- Access and learn from subject matter experts, successful former founders, and venture capitalists from M12 who can provide unlimited 1:1 guidance on topics including industry best practices, scaling your organization, go-to-market strategy, fundraising, and much more.

![Microsoft for Startups](https://mlz1ypajmcke.i.optimole.com/cb:Mstr.17319/w:1024/h:487/q:eco/f:best/https://www.feisworld.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-3.18.19-PM.png)

## How to apply for Microsoft for Startups

If the program sounds like a fit for you, getting started is really easy. Plus, Microsoft for Startups offers a lot of tutorials and helpful tips to make onboarding a breeze for you and your team. The program is open to all!

1. Apply through this link: [https://foundershub.startups.microsoft.com/signup](https://foundershub.startups.microsoft.com/signup)

![Screenshot 2023 12 15 at 3.15.44 PM | Feisworld](https://mlz1ypajmcke.i.optimole.com/cb:Mstr.17319/w:1024/h:578/q:eco/f:best/https://www.feisworld.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-3.15.44-PM.png)

2\. Log in using your LinkedIn account, and follow a simple questionnaire to provide your startup’s information.

Microsoft for Startups approves applications rather quickly. We heard back in days (not weeks). Our developers were immediately able to access benefits including free Azure credits.

[get started with microsoft for startups (free)](https://foundershub.startups.microsoft.com/signup)

## Our experience as founders behind PodIntelligence.com

My partner [Adam Leffert](https://www.fullstackdeveloper.com/) and I, cofounders of [PodIntelligence](http://podintelligence.com/), have been working on our product since early 2022. Because we are a self-funded startup, we don’t have a big marketing budget and have to rely on word-of-mouth and our existing web presence to attract new leads. In addition, we [offer free trials](http://podintelligence.com/free) to new users to experiment with our product, which can be expensive over time. Microsoft for Startups offers generous Azure credits that allow us to not only experiment with more feature development in-house but also allows us to provide more free trials to potential buyers.

There are too many benefits to name. Another one we want to shout out is free credits for LinkedIn ads. LinkedIn ads have proven to be most effective for business applications, but it’s also pricer than other options (Google ads, Facebook ads, etc.). If you haven’t experimented with LinkedIn ads, these free credits are perfect for you to experiment to test things out. Good luck driving free leads and downloads!

![Screenshot by Dropbox Capture 23 | Feisworld](https://mlz1ypajmcke.i.optimole.com/cb:Mstr.17319/w:836/h:1024/q:eco/f:best/https://www.feisworld.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Screenshot-by-Dropbox-Capture-23.png)

### Helpful Tip: Don’t redeem all your benefits at once

As exciting as it is to click on every “redeem” button and take advantage of the Microsoft for Startups benefits, we advise you redeem a few at a time and only as you have time to explore and fully benefit. This is because most of them do have an expiration date (6-12 months from when they are first redeemed).

![Screenshot 2023 12 15 at 3.44.43 PM | Feisworld](https://mlz1ypajmcke.i.optimole.com/cb:Mstr.17319/w:1024/h:358/q:eco/f:best/https://www.feisworld.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-3.44.43-PM.png)

This is also true about the different “Levels” you can unlock as part of the Microsoft for Startups program. Don’t rush yourself in moving between levels as each unlocks a new set of benefits that can expire. In short, use what you need before moving on to the next level.

## Conclusion: should you apply for Microsoft for Startups?

OMG yes! There’s no downside in trying out Microsoft for Startups. It’s 100% free and anyone can apply. I wish more founders had discovered this program on their own, and hence we are taking the time to write this article and share our authentic experience with you all. This article is not sponsored by Microsoft or Microsoft for Startups.

We hope you will consider checking out this program, and share your unique experiences with us i the comments below. Better yet, share this article and your learnings on social media, and LinkedIn and invite other creators and founders to join us.
